nom: BYOMA Clarifying Serum with Tri-Ceramide Complex

avis.titre: Treated congestion & whiteheads without overdrying - love
avis.texte: I was having a bunch of clogged pores, breakouts of hormonal acne and whiteheads, and this was *incredibly* helpful for treating them without overdrying. Other exfoliants were stripping my skin, I think, but this was amazing! Absolutely recommend

Helps prevent minor acne and light redness, feels nice. Using for a year so far. I apply AM and PM directly after washing. My skin is fragrance-sensitive and easily irritates. I see the difference when I forget to reorder this and go without for a bit!
I used to get alot of acne and ever since using this I have only gotten 1 or 2 pimples here and there but this has truly been a game changer! 100% reccomend!
I didn't see any difference with my skin after using the bottle. Love BYOMA usually but this is a dud for me.

avis.titre: Has accurate effects  as for what the product stated.
avis.texte: When I got this for Christmas and first tried it it instantly soaked into my skin saying I have very oily skin, blackheads, and pimples. I saw results overnight. This is a very good teen product. I had lots of acne scars and I have seen this Serum transform this overnight as it is much more rapidly fading away. Renimder I have only had this for 2 days.
This is fhe only thing thag haa gotten rid of the annoying bumps and texture on my chin. Ive been using for a few weeks and am IMPRESSED-especially for the price point

avis.titre: Seriously amazing, new holy grail product
avis.texte: Since using this serum, my breakouts are nearly non existent. My pores have shrunk and the general quality and texture of my skin is better.
This fully calmed my rosacea with one use and cleared my pores within 2-3 uses. I've used it for about a month now and had zero irritation, just soft, happy skin. My skin type is dry and sensitive.

I have rosacea that includes the red skin and bumpy texture and I experiment with all different types of products to find the best product for my skin. I bought this unsure of what to expect but because it has a lot of anti -inflammatory ingredients I wanted to give it a chance. This serum completely cleared up my redness and texture in just 2 days!! I didnt expect it to work so well and so fast. I'm going to keep testing it out but I am really impressed

I've had this serum since January and its currently June (and it's only just now half empty). Amazing price for how much I got out of it! Blurred out a lot of my oil-shine, also has a really nice subtle scent!

avis.titre: Really wanted to love it…but not so much!
avis.texte: I wanted to like this and was hoping it was going to help clear my skin but it made me break out worse then before!! I broke out all over and in places i normally dont break out in. I had to stop using it, pretty bummed bc i bought a ton of their skincare products.

Ive been using this serum for about 2 months now. It feels good on my skin, makes my skin soft and absorbs quickly but there are no other benefits for me. A couple hours after using it my skin feels the same as before and ive seen no change in the way my skin looks overall. I think this serum is gentle so may be good for someone with sensitive skin
Okay, so I kinda just saw this and picked it up, I didnt have expectations, but its pretty good! Other than the scent which is kinda like a herbal scent?
I didn't expect much from this, but ive had clogged pores on my forehead for awhile now, and since ive started using this I've noticed them clearing up! Very surprising! I love it

avis.titre: Didn't do much for my skin
avis.texte: I'm a very acne prone person, and I just think this serum was too gentle for me. It probably works well for minor breakouts and has good ingredients. But, I went through two bottles of this using it every night and didn't see any improvement. I did have pretty bad acne at the time I tried this though!
This is such a good serum, ive been using it for about 2 months. I can say that it COMPLETELY got ride of my milia.
This is such a phenomenal product. It's now a staple in my skin care routine. I am really enjoying all the byoma products.

I purchased this for my teenage daughter and I she seems to like it. What I would recommend is purchasing from the the store. We purchased online since it was out of stock at our store and the seal was broken. Makes me wonder if it was a return or contaminated.
But it wont jelp that much, i use it and it make my pores less noticeable but i feel like nothing really changes, it feel good on the skin. I will recommend it if u want sant a ligth weight serum.

I have highly reactive and sensitive skin. This is my first byoma product and I honestly love it. No reaction at all came from this serum and it has made my skin appear more clear. Of course patience is a virtue, especially with my heavy fungal acne and redness but its been holding up very well so far. Doesnt really smell like much either.

I have highly reactive and sensitive skin. This is my first byoma product and I honestly love it. No reaction at all came from this serum and it has made my skin appear more clear. Of course patience is a virtue, especially with my heavy fungal acne and redness but its been holding up very well so far. Doesnt really smell like much either.
this is a great product and great for the price I would recommend the only thing was that the smell wes not great kinda smells like chemicals but I am happy .

avis.titre: This product is great, but it does have some drawbacks
avis.texte: This clarifying serum is so nice! normally, serums are either super thick or oily and watery. This one however is the perfect balance. it is a little on the oily side, but it works so well and I really love it. The one con it has is that after washing my face, using toner and then putting the serum on, when I pat it into my skin, it gets sudsy, like after scrubbing your face with foaming cleanser. i don't know if this is because I don't get all the suds of when i wash my face, but that is the one con.

I absolutely love the other BYOMA serums, but this one did absolutely nothing for my skin. I do have acne-prone skin and I was hoping to add a serum that was lightweight enough for daily use / for when my skin got more congested. My skin would feel no different after I would use this, which isn't the worse outcome but it's not ideal either. I went through the whole bottle just to give it a chance but ultimately won't repurchase.

I was looking forward to trying this serum, i have combination skin type and sensitive skin and i hoped this would help my acne but i noticed more acne after use and i stopped using it after and replaced it! My skin is doing better now

This product is an awesome addition to any skincare! I love everything I have tried from this brand and have been using their products for about a year now. I can notice a difference in the texture and breakouts I have every morning after using this. It also never dries me out!

Prior to using this, i had mild acne and was looking for something to clear it up. I had been using products from Byoma before so I decided to try this product. After a two weeks of using it, my cheeks and temples broke out horrendously with acne i've never had before. I haven't used this product in over a month and i still have constant acne and scarring. I have stopped all use of their products and gone to a simple cleanser and moisturizer and have seen little improvement. I would never recommend this product.
I love this!!! Its so good for my ance pron skin but it foams up like its a cleanser!
I love this!!! Its so good for my ance pron skin but it foams up like its a cleanser!

This serum feels so nice on the skin and does a good job at clarifying my skin. I'm not acne-prone but I do have oily skin that is prone small breakouts around my nose and mouth and this serum is amazing for clearing up acne
I just got this product yesterday and I already love it. it makes my skin really soft without leaving sticky residues. would recomend

avis.titre: made me break out like crazy
avis.texte: definitely not just purging – its been weeks, and ive been breaking out quadruple the amount of before. not recommended.

I got a mini set with this serum and two other products, and this serum started clearing up my skin. Like i have acne prone/combanation skin and a lot of products/serums break me out really fast, but this serum helped me so much with hormonal breakout too.

I have very dry skin and i recently started using a oil serum and i started breaking out because of it but so far the oil serum is the only thing that keep my skin not dry and flaky so i brought this product to balance it out and its working very GOOD my acne cleared up after only a couple days, i highly recommended this product

I love this serum, I have been using it for a few months now everyday and i notice a differnce in my skin when i don't use it. I recently ran out and it was out of stock and could tell a difference in my skin. I use it every morning and night it helps so much with skin texture and acne.

Honestly, hearing how other reviews have been using the product, I probably was using it wrong because honestly I saw like barely any result. I would put I think 6 drops on the back of my hand and then with my other hand, wipe some of the serum onto my face trying to be as equal as I could, and then i rubbed it in. im not sure if i just used too much or what but honestly this did likr nothing to my skin. i liked how it was thin though! it felt pretty hydrating. i have oily acne-prone skin so I was a little bummed it didnt do much.
I have tried Byoma's brightening serum and their hydrating serum, and I have to say I LOVE this one the most. It's done a great job at clearing up my skin, 10/10 recommend!

At first this product obviously caused my skin to purge, but after using over and over as a part of my skin care routine, my skin is left feeling better, tighter, and less acne-prone overall. I do recommend to combination skin types and sensitive skin

Ive been using it for the last 3 months. It cleared up my skin without drying it out. I use 5-6 drops, on my hand and warm it up in my fingers before pressing it into my skin. I found this to be the easiest way to evenly distribute the product.

I started using this serum about two weeks ago, and I can already see a difference in my skin; it's much more glowy and clear, and this product has helped me clear my acne while on my period. Great buy!

I have insanely sensitive skin so adding new products to my regimen is risky, this was packaged very well had a wonderful consistency and smelt nice but in the end after a few weeks of use it irritated my skin and broke me out!

I was down desperate for weeks with back to back terrible break outs. I came across this serum on tik tok and decided to try it out. I saw results within the first week. Now I'm two weeks in using it, my hormonal acne is about 95% gone. I'm so happy I found this. I thought my acne would never go away.
Mine came dirty and sticky all around and so did all my othe products
it didnt really do anything for me, i got it when it was on sale and cause it was cute packaging lol but i have oily acne pron and it was just an extra step i didnt need

I saw some reviews that this product destroyed their skin but I thought I would give it a try anyways because I've been on the hunt for a barrier repair serum without pore clogging ingredients. I have been using it for a over a month now and I started noticing that my forehead was breaking out worse than I have ever seen it break out before. My friend that is an esthetician said it looked more like an allergic reaction than a breakout. I stopped using it less than a week ago and I have already noticed that my skin is clearing up. Also worth mentioning, even before it started breaking me out, I didn't notice any difference in my skin from using it.
I use this serum at night every other day and it works great. It helps to clear up any acne I have. Even if it doesn't completely get rid of it, it greatly diminishes it.

I was extremely excited to try an BYOMA product for the first time and am extremely impressed with this serum! If you're someone who prefers unscented products this is for you. Its gentle, its not sticky, and my skin feels really smooth after each use.

I have heard good things about Byoma, I've seen many videos on social media and reviews praising their skincare line. I'm a 19 year old girl who has always struggled with acne since I started puberty. Recently I started a birth control pill and had some hormonal breakouts (worse than the ones I experienced pre-pill) since I was adjusting to new hormones. This serum INSTANTLY made a difference from the day I started using it. I've noticed a decrease in my acne overall and this really helps curb breakouts. This being said, I've also used their Brightening Serum and Hydrating Serum at the same time. I use all three everyday since the day I got them and they are GREAT. The Clarifying Serum helps with breakouts, the Brightening Serum has really helped lighten some dark spots from old cystic pimples, and the Hydrating Serum balances my skin without leaving any greasy residue. I 100% recommended these products, my skin is usually sensitive to certain ingredients but I have never had a reaction to these products. I don't think I have ever left a review before but these products were so helpful for me that I felt the need to.
I use this serum at night to clear out all of the oil and build-up that gets into my skin, and it's been a great addition to my skincare routine. Haven't had any breakouts since I've used this.

I used to have very nice skin and for the past two years i was struggling, nothing worked for me, this product gave me back my skin!! My skin was red, patchy, and i would break out a lot and this product took all of that away and I dont get as many white/blackheads as well. I love that this product barely had no scent, if not at all. And works great for my sesitive skin, super refreshing, is like coffee for my skin, my favorite and I would definetly buy it again, LOVE IT!!

I bought this serum months ago. My skin was dry, patchy, and would be irritated. I tried many products, but this was the one where I noticed a difference. This serum id my HOLY GRAIL! i've noticed my skin so much clearer and healthier. Ive gotten do many questions asking how I hesled my skin. I tell them my skincare routine but ALWAYS mention how the Byoma Serum was what helped the most. If you have dry or itchy skin, or you have marks, this is for you.

I was gifted by BYOMA this product in exchange for my review. Absolutely love this serum for my combination skin. Gel amazing and my skin has been the entire time I've been using it. Love how it sinks in to my skin and doesn't feel heavy.

This serum is the best! After just a short time of use, I've already noticed my skin looking much less red and oily than usual. The serum is light and doesn't feel heavy on my skin. I also typically have very sensitive skin and this serum worked well for me!

This gentle-yet-effective clarifying facial serum balances spot-prone skin while supporting skin barrier function for a calmer, clearer complexion. I did notice a clearer look to my skin after using. Complimentary from byoma

This serum is lightweight & does not irritate my sensitive, dry skin. My skin feels refreshed and clear with constant use and it works well with other products in my routine. I love how Byoma products are effective and affordable! Gifted by Byoma.

This was gifted to me by Byuma but my opinions are my own - I really love this clarifying serum for when my skin is flaring up a little. I struggle with some hormonal breakouts and I feel like this really help along side other products to help clear it up. I truly was expecting to live it as much a so do!

avis.titre: The best clarifying serum in my skincare routine!
avis.texte: This clarifying serum that was gifted to me by BYOMA left my skin feeling so refreshed. It helped with my acne scars by diminishing them away. I use it every night and make sure to put moisturizer after.

This product was gifted by Byoma. I have normal/combo skin with some texture, enlarged pores and it's blemish prone. The texture of this serum is quite thin so it does run and you have to work it in quickly but I loved how it applied easily and sunk in fast. It didn't leave a greasy or tacky residue which was another huge plus. The ingredients are similar to some in other much more expensive products as well which is great! I found this to work well both on its own and worked into my regular skincare routine. After using this for a couple weeks I've noticed my skin does have more clarity and some beneath the surface bumps have started to go down. I had a small active breakout when I first started using it and it cleared up quicker with using this serum vs using other products I've tried. This is an awesome serum and a great value!

avis.titre: Love the focus on barrier repair!
avis.texte: This product was gifted by BYOMA in exchange for my honest opinion. I love Byoma's focus on skin barrier repair! This serum felt really nice going on - it felt very light, but not drying, and it absorbed into my skin nicely. I have very sensitive skin though, so I did notice that my skin was just slightly irritated the next morning. I'm going to slowly continue integrating this product into my routine every other night though, to see if there may be a period of time I need to get used to the product. I've had good results with Byoma's other products, so I'm interested to see how this will serve my in the long run.

I've been loving this serum. I have sensitive skin and this serum hasn't irritate it, it feels lightweight and nice on my skin, it's not sticky and doesn't clogged my pores. The redness around my cheeks has improved so much, my skin feels so soft. Complimentary from BYOMA.

I've enjoyed using this product as it really has no smell and doesn't feel heavy on my face. I also like that it doesn't feel like it's drying my face out more as I naturally have skin on the more dry side. It's been a fun add on to my daily skincare routine and leaves a nice little shine to your face but nothing dramatic. Gifted by Byoma

This product is amazing! I wasn't sure about this brand, I thought it might just be cute, but it feels amazing on my skin and really wakes it up and refreshes me in the morning and right before bed. It's the best! Gifted by Byoma

I absolutely love this Byoma Clarifying Serum, it was great for my oily, acne prone skin. It kept my breakouts at bay while I was using, I applied both morning and night and I noticed my skin looked clearer and it helped a bit with redness. It also had a light scent, and I love the applicator and how easy it is to use. Also, a little product goes a long way! I would recommend!

I used this for the first time today and it seems gentle on the skin. I'll still need to use it for a few more days to see potential results though. I like the packaging and the branding though! Super fun and cute. Gifted by BYOMA.

The serum comes in a nice, plastic package and has a characteristic smell for an acid cleanser. I like to use the serum in the evenings. It makes the skin radiant and soft. It's amazing. Gifted by brand

This is interesting and I wasn't sure to use it as an actual cleanser or drops after but I went with using this after my face was clean and it really gave my skin a clean feeling. I used this at night after showers! Gifted by BYOMA

I really liked the ingredients in this serum. I have acne prone skin and a lot of products but this product is supposed to help the skin barrier. The serum was light and there was no scent. I'm excited to see the results with continued use. Gifted by BYOMA

Gifted by BYOMA. The BYOMA clarifying serum is incredible! Using this product for just a week has made my skin to appear clearer and blemish free. Highly recommend BYOMA for oil and acne prone skin types.

This was gifted to me by BYOMA in exchange for my honest review. I love using this product as it's easy to use and effective! The dropper picks up enough product for me to use and I've noticed my skin looking brighter and more clear.
Loving this serum as it's hydrating and perfect for the day because it's a protection for your barrier skin. I tend to use it before applying SPF and it's been a good combination.

Absolutely love this byoma clarifying serum! It had zinc and PHA. I also have noticed it has helped my skin barrier as well!! I would highly recommend this product and would definitely get it again!!! gifted by byoma

I have really stubborn acne around my left cheek area and I've been looking for something to help with the breakouts. This serum has worked wonders for me, I can definitely tell it's clearing up my skin. This was gifted by BYOMA

Kindly gifted by BYOMA in exchange for my honest review. I used this serum as my treatment step in my skincare routine and I was pleasantly surprised by the results. I had a few small breakouts and after using this overnight I woke up to them being almost non-existent and calmed down so much! The overall appearance of my skin the next morning also seemed to be really improved and the tone more evened out. I really like the consistency of this serum; it's super lightweight and not sticky at all. It is hard to find an actual effective product at this price point so to say that I'm thrilled is an understatement. I will definitely be repurchasing this on my own once I run out!

I've heard so much about this brand lately and I really loved this serum! It's very lightweight and absorbed into my skin super quick. Not sticky at all and my skin felt very refreshed after using! Love it!*gifted by BYOMA*

Noticed a difference in my skin within the first week of using this product. It has cleared breakouts I would get in certain spots and has evened my skin tone. I'll keep but it. Great quality and very affordable. Highly recommended.

When I ordered this product I honestly was skeptical but as reviews were so good, I went ahead with purchase. I have combination skin with some larger pores, cpl of red sun damage spots (on nose so very visible). Wow and wow is best I can sum this product up. The pore size has reduced to look normal in trouble areas (nose/cheeks). This product is truly amazing - I swear it's dropped 5 years off of my appearance !!! I am so impressed with this product. Highly recommend! Gifted by BYOMA

I've been using the BYOMA clarifying serum for a bit now. I loved the way it feels, it is a slight sticky but not bad. I have noticed a slight difference in face so I'm hoping it only gets better. I have been adding it daily to my routine and will continue to use for as long as results last.

I've been using this for a few weeks and I like the results so far. It's a pleasant scent and the serum isn't too loose. I love the dropper feature it helps it to not make a mess when using the product.

This was kinda expensive and I didnt see a whole lot of results. By the end of the bottle the dropper couldnt reach the product and I had to dump it into my hands. Its not worth the price in my opinion.

I love my new BYOMA Clarifying Serum. My new go to daily serum. It leaves my face feeling smooth definitely will be getting more. I can definitely see a difference in my face. I highly recommend this product.

I liked using this on my face, it was really easy to use, I used a few drops after I have washed my face and my face looks smoother and healthier than ever before. Even when it's the time my face breaks out, it has helped it look healthier

My skin was 20 times worse than this since I've started using this you can see in this picture. My face has amazingly quickly and painlessly cleared up are usually put this on after I clean my face with warm water, then I'll do a toner, then the serum in my face went from being covered, especially around my period to clear and completely up in a little over a week which if you understand horrible break outs then u understand this stuff is amazing!!!

I really love this clarifying serum it dosent really have a strong smell as well which I love. I love how well it cleans my skin. I have noticed my redness going away on my skin as well i have just an overall more clear face. I highly recommend trying this out you will not be disappointed.

This product is really good at cleaning my face. I use it a couple nights in a row and I saw clear skin. It didn't even oily feel on my face and did a really good job getting deep into my pores. Recommended.

This serum is ideal for my skin; it works wonders on my skin type and accomplishes everything it claims to. I had never used this brand before, so I was trying something new. It was definitely kind to my skin, and I'd want to try other items from this company. This stuff is very great, so I would recommend it without a doubt.

I was nervous to try this serum because my skin is sensitive. I have been having bad breakouts since I've had my daughter and have not been able to keep it under control. This is a miracle in a bottle. It has helped clear up my breakouts, unclog my pores, and leaves my skin feeling soft. I like that the bottle is a dropper and you can count how many drops you need and the instructions on the bottle tell you what step to use it.

This is the first time I have tried a product by this company and they did not disappoint it has a great range of coverage and is simple to put on. It does not stand out and is a great addition to anyone's makeup bag.

I haven't been using this serum for very long, but can already tell it helps make my skin glow. I don't use it every day as I alternate between some other serums. But I like the texture and tingle when it goes on!

This serum is awesome! It does not irritate my sensitive skin. My pores and skin looks more clear and I find that I am also breaking out less. Perfect for people who have skin that needs some cleaning up.

I use this every night in my skin care routine I do love how the instructions make it clear on which step you are to use it in. It makes my skin feel and look amazing. And I love the dropper instead of a pour spout.

I didn't know what to expect when I first got this product since I hardly use any serums for my face or anything really. It is exquisite since it makes my skin shiny and look really nice. Although I'm not sure if using these types of product for for me but others may enjoy it.

I usually use a Vitamin C + Salicylic acid blend, but after becoming pregnant I was worried about the Salicylic acid component so I switched to this. It has kept my skin hydrated, and goes on lightly. I'm mainly using it to avoid clogged pores.

Okay so this is the stuff that turned me onto byoma everything! The serum is a miracle in a bottle! I have occasional breakouts and so do my teenage daughters and we all swear by this. It's done wonders without any residue, oily feeling or anything. Forever will be a staple in my skincare

The Byoma clarifying serum product worked great for my skin but I see a noticeable difference after using it. I like that it absorbs quickly on my skin. It's a very lightweight formula and thats great for layering my skincare.

I started using this a month ago and my face is very clear and my pores are all uncloged this clarifying booster has try-ceramide complex, blue tansy, pha +zinc to unclog pours with out messing up ur skin after this u need to moisture and ur skin looks great and clear.

I am always on the lookout for things that will help me and my teenage. This bottle is a nice size and I like the dropper is apart of the lid. It's easy to use we put it on our face and roll it in with a roller. It has seemed to help with breakouts and makes them not as bad, I think it's helping to cleanse the skin which is great. The bottle is cute and easy to hold and use. Overall like the product and will continue to use until its gone.

This serum is overall a great product. It goes on easily and blends well with skin. It smells good and leave the skin feeling soft and not super tight or dry. It makes my skin glow and feel healthier.

I was really surprised at how much I love the BYOMA Clarifying Serum. It helps calm inflammation, sooths my breakouts and helps decongest my pores. It also helps with the excess oil I get, without drying my skin out! It goes on really nice and absorbs into my skin quickly. I did notice after applying icy face felt a little tacky but once it is all absorbed and dried it goes away.

I don't often use serums because they feel sticky or sometimes burn, but this one does none of that. Whenever I'm consistent with it I notice a difference that I don't break out so much. It's lightweight and fits perfectly with my skincare routine.

This product is filled with amazing hydrating ingredients. However, it did not do much for my face. This being said, although it did not do much for my face after using it for around a month instead of my other hydrating products, the ingredient list is great and I would 100% recommend giving this product a try.

It dries out your skin a bit which can leave your skin feeling a bit cakey and sticky. It works for a quick make up day but it is worth the purchasing if you decide to get the product. It's a good buy

This is a high quality clarifying serum for the price point that it is sold at. I noticed my skin was smoother and clearer after using the serum. I really like that it is fragrance free and doesn't make my skin oily looking!

avis.titre: I'm not sure, but I enjoy it
avis.texte: So, I haven't seen a difference in my face. But I enjoy using the product. I am a month postpartum so, I'm trying to get my face back to what I use to. The product is nice going on and I have no reaction to it. Due to the sensitivity of my skin which is a plus. I will continue to use it until it's all gone, since I see no bad changes to my face.

avis.titre: Love this stuff when I'm breaking out!
avis.texte: I love this stuff for when I'm having a bad skin day and my skin is breaking out. Helps keep my skin clear looking and clean while also adding a wonderful glow. Helps me feel like it dulls the redness of my skin.

To be honest, I haven't noticed much of a difference in the lightening of my complexion, but I really appreciate it because it makes my skin feel really soft and refreshed. I'll wait till I finish the entire serum to see if I notice anything.

I have been using this clarifying serum from Byoma for exactly three weeks now, and I am sooo impressed with it. I began to notice a difference with the redness in my cheeks lessening within the first two days of use, using both morning and night. I continued use for the next three weeks and saw even more improvement in balancing my skin tone and calming down the natural redness in my cheeks, easing breakouts, and improving the appearance of my pores. I am pregnant and during my second trimester my skin started to break out a bit more than usual. Within a week and a half of using this consistently, the breakouts cleared up completely. The instructions are very clear and don't leave any room for confusion about how much to apply (4-6 drops is specified, I use 4), when to apply (AM&PM and what part of your skin routine), or how to apply (gently press into skin). I very much appreciate not having to guess if I'm using the product correctly. It leaves a slight stickiness or tackiness for about 20-25 seconds, but then dries and you can quickly move on with your skincare routine. The bottle is a good size and using 4 drops per application, should last quite a while. This is my first product from Byoma, but after how well this serum has worked for me, I'm really interested in trying more of their products!
